Jharkhand News: jharkhand ki bari khabren | Nisha Bhagat | PM Modi | Diwali 2026 | Pollution | Ranchi |JMM
Jharkhand men dipavli ke bad barha pradushan...rajdhani samet kaee jilon men aasman men chhaee dhundh aur dhuen ki parat...ranchi ka PM10 star 171.68 ke par pahuncha..
Hajaribag ke burhva mahadev mandir men adhikar ko lekar hangama...kandatri aur guruchatti ke gramin bhire... jamkar huee pattharbaji...pulis ne sanbhala morcha...
Jamshedpur ke aajad nagar men rangdari ko lekar golibari...do log ghayal...aspatal men bharti...chana vasim par goli chalane ka aarop...
